lessons.notes: Scripted lesson spanning pages 45, 48, 49 (book pp. 37-39); opens the Lessons 21-30 unit (more practice with segmenting/blending plus reviews of vowel and consonant sounds; consonant k and letter combinations ch, sh, th, ck are introduced). Letters arranged vowel first then alphabetical (i, h, k, n, t). Children hold up t and h: together they make the sound at the beginning of 'thumbs' (wiggle thumbs and make the th sound). Cues: it (2 letters); in (change the last letter in it); ink (add a letter to i-n); tin and kit (clear holders, spell another 3-letter word); hit (change just the first letter); hint (add 1 letter to hit, stretch the word to hear which letter and where); thin (use the same 4 letters in hint but move them around; wiggle your thumbs); think (add the k to thin). Part Two: sort for the letter sounds i, h, k, t, and th; five children sort by first letter, with thin/think in a separate th column (th together makes the sound heard in thumbs).

lessons.notes: Fully scripted three-part lesson spanning book pages 129-131 (pngs 143-145). Part One: Making Words with teacher script and example sentences for each word; letters arranged vowel-first then alphabetical. Part Two: Sorting Words for patterns o, ook, ake, ack; teacher reviews how each word was changed, then lines up rhyme columns headed so/cook/bake/back. Part Three: Transfer (shook, shake, brook). boo and case/sock made during lesson; sock (-ock) and boo are not placed in the four sort columns. Secret word formed by combining book + case.
